debug_mode.description: Enable detailed internal logging and diagnostics for troubleshooting

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warning, error, critical

runtime_dir.description: Directory to store runtime data (temp files, sockets, etc.)

config_dir.description: Directory to store persistent configuration files

pid_file.description: Full path to the process ID file

service_name.description: Short name used to identify this service in logs and process listings

bind_address.description: IP address or hostname the service binds to

port.description: TCP port for incoming client connections

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections

connection_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to keep a client connection alive without activity

backend_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a response from a backend server

retry_attempts.description: Number of times to retry a failed backend request

retry_delay.description: Milliseconds to wait between retry attempts

worker_count.description: Number of worker processes to spawn for handling requests

worker_graceful_reload.description: When true, workers reload configuration without dropping active connections

worker_idle_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity after which a worker process is restarted

worker_memory_limit.description: Maximum megabytes of memory a worker may use before automatic restart

enable_compression.description: Enable gzip/deflate compression for text responses

enable_access_log.description: Log successful requests to access log

enable_error_log.description: Log error conditions (5xx responses, crashes, etc.)

ssl_enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for HTTPS connections

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (PEM format)

ssl_key_file.description: Path to the SSL private key file (PEM format)

ssl_ca_file.description: Optional path to the CA bundle for client certificate verification

ssl_protocols.description: List of acceptable SSL/TLS protocols (e.g., TLSv1.2, TLSv1.3)

ssl_prefer_server_ciphers.description: Use server's cipher preference instead of client's

ssl_session_cache_size.description: Number of SSL sessions to cache

ssl_session_timeout.description: Seconds an SSL session remains valid in cache

backends.description: List of backend servers to forward client requests to

address.description: Backend server hostname or IP address

health_check.description: Enable periodic health checks for this backend

health_check_uri.description: Path used to probe backend health

healthy_threshold.description: Consecutive successes required to mark backend as healthy

unhealthy_threshold.description: Consecutive failures required to mark backend as unhealthy

rate_limit_requests_per_second.description: Maximum requests per second per client before throttling

rate_limit_burst.description: Maximum burst size (requests allowed in short bursts)

request_body_limit.description: Maximum allowed request body size in kilobytes

origin_validation_enabled.description: Validate the Origin header against allowed origins (CORS)

allowed_origins.description: List of allowed origins for CORS requests (e.g., https://example.com)

items.description: Allowed origin URL (scheme + host + optional port/path)
